notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 7.
description:
Activate Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least seven {G}
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Wirewood Lodge.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Formidable Speaker.
Activate Formidable Speaker by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Candelabra of Tawnos.
Repeat.
